sources.fact: LBBD17/BO Elim Pentecostal Church, 194 Ripple Road is 0.06ha, 9 minimum/maximum net dwellings and the current entry carries planning-permission-status permissioned.
The same current Brownfield record explicitly states Notes: Lapsed; that note is preserved and prevents treating the old permission as an extant current consent.
The record gives full planning permission date 9 February 2016 and planning-history id 14160.
The current Brownfield record provides a point and blank geometry; the point is not an application red-line or HMLR title polygon.
Ownership status not-owned-by-a-public-authority does not identify the legal proprietor or title number.
The 8 February 2016 Planning Committee minutes identify application 15/01099/FUL at 194 Ripple Road and grant planning permission for a replacement church with 9 flats above.
The exact approved residential mix was 4 one-bedroom and 5 two-bedroom flats, totalling 9.
Planning Data's older brownfield-site dataset contains an LBBD17 multipolygon for the church site; it is historical register geometry rather than an HMLR title polygon.
The older brownfield-site point/polygon is retained only as historic register identity support and is not promoted to current legal parcel evidence.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission.
The adopted Local Plan provides policy/allocation context but does not revive a lapsed planning permission.
Development-plan status guides decisions and is kept separate from the current legal status of a historic consent.

examples.result: BO retains 9-home capacity but the recorded permission is explicitly lapsed.
15/01099/FUL is exact historic permission evidence for replacement church plus 9 flats.
4 one-bed + 5 two-bed = 9; no units are imported from neighbouring Ripple Road sites.
The lapsed note prevents treating the permissioned field as proof of an extant current consent.
Current point/blank geometry is not converted into a synthetic red-line.
Historic LBBD17 polygon is not converted into a legal title polygon.
Non-public ownership category is not proprietor identification.
Promotion remains zero until a current exact consent/site/title relation and statutory overlays are verified.
